name: CORPONATION WARS: Expansion Protocol
description: A collectible card game published by HelixCorp's entertainment subsidiary, where players build decks representing rival corponation portfolios — legal, military, media, and biological assets — and compete through legislative maneuvering, hostile acquisition, and targeted infrastructure sabotage. Physical cards use smart-ink that animates faction logos and redacts card text when played against certain combinations, simulating corporate information blackouts. A neural booster pack exists for BCI-equipped players that overlays holographic boardroom simulations during play.
story_hooks: A competitive player's custom deck contains a card that shouldn't exist — a corponation that was supposedly liquidated in 2198 — and the card's smart-ink updates in real time with what appears to be live intelligence.
The underground circuit's stripped-branding decks have become so accurate that corponation security divisions are now fielding agents to infiltrate tournaments and identify who is sourcing the data.

A child prodigy from the Shelf is winning Tier 3 sanctioned tournaments using a deck built entirely from salvaged and hand-altered cards, exposing how much of the game's 'balance' is engineered around expensive rare pulls.
